shortDesc: Crawler and search indexer for the IIT KGP CSE department website.
fullDesc:
A custom web crawler, parser, and search indexer built to index and query information from all subpages of the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur Computer Science & Engineering department website.

Core Idea:
The scraper traverses site structures, extracts text, announcements, faculty directories, and course material links, and structures them into a queryable local database, serving as a fast search utility for students and faculty.
highlights: Traverses deep nested structures of the CSE IIT KGP department site
Extracts structured datasets for research papers, notices, and directories
Builds a queryable local index for rapid search and matching
